dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS, non-germinal-center B-cell-like by the Hans algorithm, double-expressor by immunohistochemistry

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: De novo DLBCL with a non-GCB/ABC-like immunophenotype (CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1 positive)

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: no cytokeratin or GATA3 expression to suggest metastatic breast carcinoma

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage IIIB: lymph node regions above and below the diaphragm (left axillary/mediastinal and mesenteric/para-aortic) plus splenic involvement, with B symptoms

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: Ann Arbor stage IIIB: lymph node regions above and below the diaphragm (left axillary/mediastinal and mesenteric/para-aortic) plus splenic involvement, with B symptoms

stage_b_symptoms.quote: with B symptoms (evening fevers and drenching night sweats)

stage_bulk_definition.quote: The largest mass is a 7.5 cm mesenteric conglomerate, below the NCCN >=10 cm bulky threshold but still a large mass that increases tumor-lysis risk.

mn_stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IIIB: lymph node regions above and below the diaphragm

mol_del_not_dh.quote: double-expressor biology (MYC >=40% and BCL2 >=50% by IHC) but not double-hit lymphoma (MYC/BCL2/BCL6 FISH negative)

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: but not double-hit lymphoma (MYC/BCL2/BCL6 FISH negative)

mn_da_epoch.quote: there is no validated first-line targeted escalation; the cardiac contraindication to anthracycline is the dominant treatment constraint.

prog_ipi_2.quote: IPI 2 (stage III and elevated LDH; age 59, ECOG 1, and no extranodal sites), which is low-intermediate by the standard IPI

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: CNS-IPI 2, intermediate risk (age 59, stage III, elevated LDH; ECOG 1, no more than one extranodal site, and no kidney or adrenal involvement)

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: I will not give intrathecal methotrexate or routine CSF analysis.

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: I will not give intrathecal methotrexate or routine CSF analysis.

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: I am deliberately avoiding R-CHOP and pola-R-CHP because both contain doxorubicin, and she has prior cumulative doxorubicin 240 mg/m2, left breast radiotherapy, hypertension, and an asymptomatic LVEF of 45%

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: I am deliberately avoiding R-CHOP and pola-R-CHP because both contain doxorubicin

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: Before starting therapy I still need baseline ECG/QTc, cardiac troponin and NT-proBNP, formal cardiology evaluation with a heart-failure treatment plan

tx_cardioprotection.quote: Obtain cardiology co-management and start an ACE inhibitor or ARB plus a beta-blocker for asymptomatic cancer-therapy-related cardiac dysfunction.

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: Curative-intent R-CEOP for 6 cycles every 21 days: rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV day 1, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 IV day 1, etoposide 100 mg/m2 IV days 1-3

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: I will explicitly discuss that anthracycline-free therapy is chosen for cardiac safety and that some series suggest slightly lower efficacy than R-CHOP, especially with double-expressor biology

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: monitor blood pressure, weight, edema, troponin, and repeat echocardiography; avoid further anthracycline.

mn_non_curative.quote: Curative-intent R-CEOP for 6 cycles every 21 days

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment FDG PET-CT using Lugano 2014/Deauville criteria at approximately 6-8 weeks after cycle 6, interpreted against the baseline PET

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor-lysis prophylaxis with allopurinol 300 mg daily (renally adjusted) and vigorous hydration, with baseline and post-cycle potassium, phosphorus, calcium, uric acid, and creatinine

sup_gcsf.quote: Primary G-CSF prophylaxis with pegfilgrastim 6 mg on day 2 (or filgrastim) because of etoposide-related febrile neutropenia risk.

sup_anastrozole.quote: Continue anastrozole through chemotherapy and complete the planned 10-year course in November 2026.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis B antiviral prophylaxis is not needed (HBsAg and anti-HBc negative); she is nonimmune, so plan HBV vaccination.

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: She is fit for curative-intent combination chemotherapy: age 59, ECOG 1, independent, working full-time, NYHA class I, normal renal and hepatic function, and strong social support.

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: Baseline cardiac biomarkers (troponin and NT-proBNP) and a formal cardiology/heart-failure assessment, including the exact plan and timeline for ACE inhibitor or ARB and beta-blocker initiation and repeat echocardiography.
